image_description: A museum display of an ancient, heavily corroded bronze breastplate (cuirass). The armor is shaped to fit a human torso with defined pectoral and abdominal contours. It features a greenish patina (verdigris) covering most of the surface, indicating age and oxidation, with patches of underlying brown metal visible. Small attachment loops are visible along the edges.
